title: Zesty Indulgent Mexican Ovoli Mushroom Quesadilla
description: A jammy and flaky Mexican dish featuring ovoli mushrooms in a quesadilla, perfect for ovo-vegetarian diets, made using papillote for added flavor and texture. This indulgent dish is sure to satisfy any craving.

ingredients.name: Papillote spices
ingredients.notes: mix of cumin, chili powder, and oregano

instructions: Preheat a large skillet over medium heat and brush with vegetable oil.
Add the diced onion and cook until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute, until fragrant.
Add the sliced ovoli mushrooms and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown, about 5 minutes.
Add the papillote spices and stir to combine, cooking for 1 minute.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked mushroom mixture and shredded cheese, stirring to combine.
Place a large tortilla in the skillet and sprinkle a quarter of the mushroom and cheese mixture onto half of the tortilla.
Fold the tortilla in half to enclose the filling and cook until the tortilla is crispy and the cheese is melted, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Repeat with the remaining tortillas and filling.
Serve the quesadillas hot with sour cream, chopped cilantro, and a squeeze of lime juice.
Cut into wedges and serve immediately.
